warnings.message: Same full target sentence is reused across multiple scored activities.

manualReview.scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of Lesson 0112; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: ‘I was here once.’ and ‘I was there once too.’ are natural short uses of once meaning on one occasion.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian consistently renders once as «یک بار».

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Recognition, guided exchange, place transfer and hidden retrieval form a clear progression.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors contrast time and quality meanings without random noise.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Talking about previous visits to a museum and cafe naturally elicits once.

difficultyFit.evidence: The learner output is short and controlled; past be is support rather than a new assessed target.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: once is reused across comprehension, choice and production.

transferQuality.evidence: The second turn changes the location while preserving the one-occasion meaning.

overallCoherence.evidence: Outcome, scenario and assessment remain within one bounded sense.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed.

limitations: No independent human or learner test has been performed.
Only the one-occasion sense of once is reviewed.
Audio prosody is not evaluated at this stage.
resolvedFindings: Past be is not claimed as new grammar.
Character pair and learner role rotate from the previous Lesson.
